principles: Speed is the feature: Animations must be tight (150-200ms).
Black is not just #000: Use depth (#0A0A0F -> #121218 -> #1A1A24).
Neon signals value: Use electric colors ONLY for savings and actions.
Density is luxury: Don't be afraid of tight data, but keep it legible.

font_family.heading: System Sans-Serif (iOS: San Francisco, Android: Roboto) - Weight: 800/900
font_family.mono: System Monospace (iOS: Menlo, Android: Monospace) - For prices and timers

visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid full screen gradients. Use subtle radial gradients in backgrounds using SVGs if possible, or keep it flat and clean for performance.

motion.guidelines: Use React Native Animated API or Reanimated. Animations should be snappy.

transitions.press: Scale down to 0.98 on pressIn, back to 1 on pressOut.

media.icons: Use @expo/vector-icons (Feather or Ionicons preferred for thin, sharp look).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is #FFFFFF or #E4E4E7 on dark backgrounds. Avoid dark grey on black.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44 points for all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a 'testID' (React Native prop) or 'accessibilityLabel'.

instructions_to_main_agent.core_rule: Do NOT use HTML elements (div, span). Use View, Text, TouchableOpacity, Image.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Use StyleSheet.create(). Do not use inline styles for static values.
instructions_to_main_agent.safe_area: Always wrap screen content in SafeAreaView (from react-native-safe-area-context) or use appropriate padding.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Import from @expo/vector-icons. Example: import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
instructions_to_main_agent.mock_data: Create a robust mock data file for the 8 platforms with varied prices and delivery times to show off the sorting logic.

universal_guidelines: No gradients on text (hard to do in RN, avoid complexity).
Use distinct visual weight for 'Best Price' vs 'Fastest Delivery'.
Ensure keyboard handling (KeyboardAvoidingView) for the search input.
Redirect screen must feel like a 'hyperspace jump' - fast, pulsing, exciting.
